rationale: C1 is a budget speech stating a plan under the River Conservation Project (monitoring stations 'will' be established); no GO or launch of river cleaning work in the named rivers. C2-C5 concern soil conservation, desilting and climate/wetland missions, not this project.

rationale: C2-C4 only list PDS subjects, including the 1977 display-of-stocks order, in an RTI allocation GO. C1's digital boards are for Uzhavar Santhais and regulated markets, not ration shops. No step for digital boards in ration shops.

cited.quote: from Chief Minister Public Relief Fund to each to the 34 legal heirs of Government Doctors/Private Doctors/Health Inspector
for disbursement to the legal heirs of the 32 deceased front line workers

rationale: C1 (GO dated 06.08.2021) sanctions Rs.25 lakh each to legal heirs of doctors, a health inspector and a ward assistant who died of Covid on frontline duty; C3 authorises disbursement. No extract shows compensation for nurses, other frontline workers or police personnel, so only part of the commitment is covered.

cited.quote: to extend the scope of assistance for medical treatments available under the existing Scheme

C2 describes existing student schemes without increases.

rationale: C1/C2 (GO dated 2021-10-11) issue guidelines for special camps in every revenue village to take public applications on patta issues. The promise's 'these issues' is unspecified, so whether patta matters are the intended issues is uncertain.
